Frontend: cookie banner accepted; ecosystem-orbit renders on desktop 1920px with GESOI center (larger, gold border) + PERDOSNI/otaQku/ICC satellites, hover reveals description tooltips, SVG dashed connectors present; on mobile 390px orbit hidden and ecosystem-card-* grid visible. Publication flow: publication-buy-btn-0 opens checkout-modal with prototype-note + order-form, filled name/email/phone/organization → order-submit-btn → modal closes → order persisted in backend (verified via GET /api/admin/orders returning TEST_UI_Buyer with pending status). Admin: login → admin-tab-pembelian shows admin-orders with orders-stat-total/pending/contacted/completed (correct counts), orders-table populated, native <select> order-status-{id} changes status; reload preserves change (contacted persisted). orders-export-csv-btn present. Data Pendaftar tab + Export CSV regression OK. EN language toggle switches placeholders to 'Full name' / 'WhatsApp number' correctly. CMS layout switch: Editor Website → 02 — Ekosistem → Tata Letak select to 'grid' → Simpan → landing shows ecosystem-card-gesoi (visible) and NO ecosystem-orbit; editor-reset-btn restores default → landing shows orbit again (verified). Join form submits and shows success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: Publications.js line 31: sends `organization: buyer.organization || null` but backend Pydantic OrderCreate has organization Optional[str] = None — null works, minor: could omit key instead.
OrderCreate Pydantic model does not validate `status` field on create (defaults to 'pending' via Order model) — correct pattern, no issue.
PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id} uses plain dict Body instead of Pydantic model — validation only on server-side string comparison. Acceptable but a StatusUpdate BaseModel would be cleaner.

Ecosystem.js OrbitLayout uses fixed pixel positions in SVG lines (viewBox 1000x520 with preserveAspectRatio=none) — line endings visually approximate; connectors may look slightly off if container width changes drastically. Currently fine at lg+ breakpoints.

Order model returns created_at as datetime (Pydantic serializes ISO string in response), but stored as ISO string in Mongo — round-trip works, dual code path (line 172-173 re-parse) is slightly redundant but functional.
No pagination on GET /api/admin/orders (limit 1000). Fine for MVP scale; consider pagination when order count grows.
